beforeId.description: Keyset cursor: a reply id from a previous page

includeMembers.description: Squad id only: true lists the squad's own posts plus every active member's, newest first (TIMESTAMP sort only on the callouts read); ignored on a person id. Re-send it with every beforeId request.

replies.description: Newest first; a page shorter than the requested limit marks the end. The user's own dead replies are simply absent

callout.description: null when the callout is deleted or moderation-hidden

parent.description: null when the reply targets the callout directly

verifiedBadgeVisible.description: Badge rendering hint beside isVerified: show the checkmark only when both are true; true for user-less callouts

accountKind.description: 'group' = a squad callout: userId/userName/profileImage are the squad's while walletAddress is the acting admin's posting wallet; route the author press on userId + accountKind, never the wallet

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref; absent when the callout carries none

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

verifiedBadgeVisible.description: Badge rendering hint beside isVerified: show the checkmark only when both are true; true for user-less callouts

accountKind.description: 'group' = a squad callout: userId/userName/profileImage are the squad's while walletAddress is the acting admin's posting wallet; route the author press on userId + accountKind, never the wallet

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref; absent when the callout carries none

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

421504.mediaWaveform.description: Loudness shape of an attached voice note for a waveform player: 64 buckets 0..100, 100 = the clip's loudest bucket; absent on every other callout and on voice notes recorded before the waveform shipped

calloutId.description: cc's callout UUID; a row cc serves without one is mapped to callout null, so the key is never empty

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref (hlcore:mainnet for a perp, ton:-239 for a TON callout, near:mainnet for a NEAR callout, starknet:SN_MAIN for a Starknet callout); null when the row carries none

assetClass.description: Asset class of the called-out position: ASSET_CLASS_PERPETUAL on an hlcore (HyperCore perp) callout, ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE on a card callout (collectible set), ASSET_CLASS_TOKEN on every other row, chainless ones included

collectible.description: ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE callouts only: the card (identity, grade, mark, insured value, buyback, listing); multiple is then the card mark over calloutPrice. Absent on every token callout

perp.description: Set only on a perp callout, whose calledOutAtMcap is 0

calledOutAtMcap.description: USD market cap when the callout was made; 0 when coin-communities captured none, never null

multiple.description: Current multiplier (live price vs callout price), 1 for an untracked callout; maxMultiplier is the all-time peak

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

hasLiked.description: null until a viewer is known

updates.description: Author updates (the author's own replies), newest first; empty when the route does not include them

commentCount.description: Live replies from users OTHER than the callout author

calloutPrice.description: Token price when the callout was made; 0 for callouts predating price capture, never null

repostCount.description: Live plain reposts of the callout itself; quotes do not count

hasReposted.description: null until a viewer is known

quotedCalloutId.description: Set with quotedCallout null means "quote of an unavailable callout", never "no quote"

actingUserId.description: Squad callouts: the admin who posted on the squad's behalf; presence is not the squad discriminator, the author's kind is

actingUser.description: actingUserId set with actingUser null means "unresolved", not "absent"

quotedCallout.description: The quoted callout one level deep (its own quotedCallout is always null)

assetId.description: The card's Metaplex Core asset id or pNFT mint

anyOf.description: Card provider. Known values: collector_crypt, phygitals
Lifecycle state of the card; listed while a marketplace listing is live. Known values: held, listed, bought_back, sold, redeemed, seized, burned, inventory

grade.description: Grading company and grade as one label (PSA 10); null ungraded

markUsd.description: The PnL mark the row's tokenPriceUsd and valueUsd rest on; null = unpriced

markSource.description: Price source the mark was picked from (buyback, standing_bid, fmv, listing, ...); null when unpriced

markAsOf.description: ISO instant the mark was observed

insuredValueUsd.description: Provider insured value; display only, never the mark

buybackValueUsd.description: The provider's current buyback quote; null when none stands

buybackExpiresAt.description: ISO instant the buyback quote lapses; null = no expiry

listing.description: Live marketplace listing; null when not listed

anyOf.description: Marketplace the card is listed on. Known values: collector_crypt, magic_eden, tensor, phygitals

421504.local:a.description: Session-deduped views; absent means unknown (no counter row yet), never a real zero

verifiedBadgeVisible.description: Badge rendering hint beside isVerified: show the checkmark only when both are true

accountKind.description: 'group' = a squad reply posted by an acting admin: userId/userName/profileImage are the squad's and walletAddress is null (groups are walletless)

parentMessageId.description: null when this reply targets the callout itself

threadReplyCount.description: Live descendants at every depth; thread tops only

tombstone.description: Placeholder for a deleted/hidden reply — only id, linkage and counts are set

hasLiked.description: null for anonymous requests and on tombstones

viewerFollowsAuthor.description: null for anonymous requests and on tombstones

positionCostBasisAmount.description: cc zeroes it on exit; use the amountBought pair for lifetime entry

isQuote.description: Quote rows root their own thread and never appear in the quoted thread; always false on tombstones

previewReplies.description: Newest live direct children, deduped against authorReply; empty without nestedLimit

authorReply.description: The callout author's earliest live direct child
